ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in circle $\odot O$, C and D are two points on circle $\odot O$, and AB is the diameter of $\odot O$. Given that $\angle AOC = 130^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle BDC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle AOC=130^\circ$ and AB is the diameter of $\odot O$,\\
it follows that $\angle BOC=180^\circ-\angle AOC=50^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle BDC= \frac{1}{2}\angle BOC=\boxed{25^\circ}$.
